daily_aggregation.deduplication: Exact timestamps are deduplicated; the June update workbook wins exact overlaps.
daily_aggregation.rainfall: The cumulative station rainfall counter is converted to one daily value using its maximum. Readings above 150 mm are rejected as sensor errors.
daily_aggregation.usable_day: At least 12 readings spanning at least 6 hours.

forecast_rule: Lag features use dates strictly earlier than the target date. Same-day features use only station readings timestamped before 06:00 local time.
limitations: TRI-TW is a regional station and may not capture every estate field microclimate.
Weather improves productivity prediction only if it wins the untouched temporal test.
A future plan uses the weather model only when observations are recent; otherwise the no-weather model or historical fallback is used.
